column3: “Arise into the midst” is rendered “Get up and come forward!”
“Do evil” is rendered “do harm,” and “were silent” is “kept silent.”
NASB follows the critical text without “sound as the other.”
NASB renders “a great multitude” as “a great number of people.”
“Wait upon Him” is rendered “stand ready for Him.”
NASB lacks “whom He also named apostles,” which the critical text includes.
NASB follows the critical text without “to heal diseases and.”
NASB follows the critical text with “He appointed the twelve” and puts the naming of Peter in parentheses.
NASB puts the naming in parentheses and renders “which is” as “which means.”
NASB renders “to a house” as “home” and “bread” as “a meal.”
“Those belonging to Him” is rendered “His own people,” “seize” is “take custody of,” and “He is crazy” is “He has lost His senses.”
“He has Beelzebul” is rendered “He is possessed by Beelzebul,” and “prince” is “ruler.”
“An end is coming” is rendered “he is finished!”
NASB renders “as much as they shall have blasphemed” as “whatever blasphemies they utter.”
